description: This file contains the implementation of an Oracle database driver for the ADODB database abstraction library in PHP, specifically using PDO (PHP Data Objects). It defines driver-specific properties and methods for interacting with Oracle databases via PDO.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_oci
classes.description: A PHP class implementing an Oracle PDO driver, extending the base PDO driver, with properties and methods tailored for Oracle database interaction.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the driver with specific session settings, such as date format.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about tables, with optional filtering by name pattern.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns of a specified table.

methods.name: SetAutoCommit
methods.description: Sets the autocommit mode for the database connection.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Returns a driver-specific placeholder for bind parameters.
